rooms.name: The Immortal Map Room of the Elemental Temple
rooms.desc:
The temple will be broken up into 6 components - the initial entry which
is now underwater, a plane for each element and a temple for the fifth element.
Players will only be able to progress to an elemental plane if they possess
the previous plane items. For example, if the player has obtained the item
from the earthen plane, they'll be taken to the aerial plane and so on. Here's
a brief map.

rooms.name: Beneath the Surface
rooms.desc:
Light filters down through the ocean surface above and is quickly swallowed
by the depths below. Small groups of fish swim by, obviously cautious of your
intrusion in their domain. Every direction looks fairly similar so you may
either swim upwards to the surface and descend into the darkness below.

rooms.name: Deep Beneath the Surface
rooms.desc:
Darkness surrounds you like a blanket and you strain your eyes in an attempt
to see anything at all that would help you regain your orientation. You can
just sense a difference in temperature and determine which way is up and
which way is down. You're not quite sure, but a hidden presence speaks to you
from the depths - then again, it could just be your imagination running wild.

rooms.name: The Depths of the Ocean
rooms.desc:
The only way you know you're skimming the ocean floor is by feeling the
sand slip between your fingers as you try to keep yourself down here. Your
ears pop under the increased pressure at this depth and how long you stay
down here is up to you, especially with the immense cold. For a brief instant,
you could have sworn you saw a flicker of light to the south.

rooms.name: The Depths of the Ocean
rooms.desc:
It is surprising that even in the darkness of the ocean depths, the fish
find a way to adapt and survive. A few of them have developed a phospherescent
skin that radiates a small amount of light - not enough to see great distances
but certainly enough to know you've arrived at the mouth of an underwater
tunnel that leads to the north and south.

rooms.name: The Depths of the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You make your way along the underwater tunnel that runs to the north and
south by feeling your way along the rocky walls. More than once, you stumble
and slip on the sandy ocean floor but fortunately do not hurt yourself.

rooms.name: The Depths of the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You stand at the mouth of an underwater tunnel that continues to the north.
The darkness of the ocean kept at bay by a magical light to the south in what
looks like a courtyard. The water temperature is also noticeably warmer in
that direction, perhaps another benefit of whatever magic inhabits this place.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
The courtyard floor is slightly uneven and your travel to the west or
north is blocked by a large rock wall. Looking upwards, you can see the
remains of a tree, somehow preserved against the ravages of the salt water
and cold temperatures.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You find it unlikely that someone would have created this place underwater
so perhaps at some time it was on the surface. Your thoughts are supported by
a number of crumbled and fallen columns which block several areas of the
courtyard. There is something around this place, magical in nature, but you
can't quite put your finger on it.
   To the north, a rocky tunnel leads back into the depths of the ocean while
the courtyard continues to the south, west and east of here.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You reach the edge of the courtyard and can progress no further, a rock
wall preventing travel to the north and east while a collapsed column to the
south stops you from moving in that direction. You consider swimming over the
top of it but there is a strange magic at work here that seems to keep you
firmly planted on the ground.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
Rubble is strewn all over the ground, covered lightly in sand. A large,
cracked column has fallen and blocks your path to the south but the courtyard
lies open to the north and east.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
At one time, this courtyard would have looked quite grand with the ocean
as its backdrop and sunlight streaming through the surrounding columns. Now,
it is just a shadow of its former glory. The columns have collapsed, the
sunlight blocked by a few hundred feet of water and all you can see around
the edge of the courtyard is a rocky wall. You can swim to the north, west
or south.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
To the south, several steps lead up to what remains of a gate while the
underwater courtyard lies to the north and east. Climbing a few of the steps,
you look back upon the courtyard and marvel at what it must have been like in
the past. The are four short pillars nearby but there is nothing to provide
clues as to what they are for.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You have to swim through some rubble to get here and perhaps it was not
worth the effort. You are surrounded by rock and stone and have no alternative
but to return back to the west.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
Stairs lead upwards to the south towards an elevated platform of some kind.
There are flashes of light but it's not quite clear from here - to the north,
the underwater courtyard opens up before you and offers the only visible
exit from this place, whatever it is.

rooms.name: A Glowing Column
rooms.desc:
You're not exactly sure what you're standing in, but it's impressive to say
the least. It's a perfectly shaped column standing approximately 10 feet high
and hollow in the center. Spirals of flame encircle the column although you
can feel no heat; the ocean waters stir about you, churned by a mystical
force; several small orbs of stone cover the ground and bubbles of air
mysteriously rise from beneath them.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
The plateau appears to be perfectly square and has rocky pillars placed
at regular intervals around its border. Any attempt to walk past the pillars
is met with some kind of resistance, possibly the sphere that surrounds this
place.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You walk along the nortern edge of the plateau and gaze around. Beyond the
sphere there is only darkness, although you can see three other spheres of
similar size in the distance surrounding a larger sphere. From here, you
cannot determine what's in them.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You carefully approach the corner of the rocky plateau and look over the
side...you can see absolutely nothing! It's not that its too dark down there,
just that there is nothing to see. Whatever, or wherever this place is, there
doesn't appear to be any obvious way off it.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
It may only be a visual illusion, but the plateau looks almost generated
rather than formed. Someone or something has gone to great efforts to construct
this place with an almost eerie precision. Every little bump in the ground
appears in another area, as if the plateau had been created using several
replicated blocks. The only difference is the rocky outcrop to the east.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You stand atop a slightly elevated rocky outcrop overlooking a square
plateau below. There are a number of pillars placed around its border and
a central column within which you are standing. Some kind of sphere surrounds
the plateau and isolates it from whatever lies beyond.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You skirt the edge of a rocky platform which sits just above you to the
west, the plateau extending to the north and south. Any attempt to move past
the pillars surrounding the plateau is met with resistance, most likely from
the sphere.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
There's something moving just beyond the edge of the sphere but you can't
determine what it is from here. You can even see what appears to be a soft
glow far beyond the sphere to the south but that could just be your
imagination. The plateau extends to the north and east from here.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You clamber up one of the waist-high pillars in an attempt to get a better
view of your surrounds but it doesn't help too much. The plateau looks
remarkably similar whichever way you cast your eye and the sphere surrounding
it either blocks out light or there is none beyond it to see.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You accidently kick a small stone on the ground and it careers off the
edge of the plateau before striking the sphere. A ripple forms and expands
all over the surface of the sphere, like throwing a pebble in a lake. It's
an interesting sight and leaves you wondering what, or where, this place
really is.

rooms.name: The Earthly Plane
rooms.desc:
You stand on a single platform of rock in a place far beyond any you have
travelled before. There is no sky, nor is there any ground...all around you
is darkness. There are several similar rocky platforms but they all lie
beyond your reach. In the center of the platform is a strange column that
rotates slowly.

rooms.name: The Earthly Plane
rooms.desc:
You step towards the edge of platform and you feel a tingling sensation
all over your body. There is a brilliant flash and when you open your eyes,
you find yourself...

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
Wispy cloud swirls around your ankles, disturbed by your passage. Beyond
the sphere, you see three similar spheres of the same size surrounding a
larger sphere. You cannot be sure what lies within the other spheres or their
intent.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
You carefully approach the edge of the cloud and look out upon your
surroundings. Surprisingly, there is no sky and there doesn't appear to be
any ground! Only darkness surrounds the sphere which leaves you wondering
exactly where you are...

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
Every once in a while, you get the sensation that you are moving. Without
a place of reference, that may well be true but the sensation quickly passes
and you are once again left with your thoughts. You may continue around the
cloud to the west or south.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
You walk towards the edge of the cloud and reach out, inspecting the sphere
that surrounds this cloud. It is soft to the touch and moves freely with your
touch, yet its purpose is still unknown. It ripples softly as you remove your
hand and you watch in awe as the ripples spread across the spheres' surface.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
You stand atop what can only be described as a cloud! For a moment, you
panic at the thought of falling but the ground beneath your feet feels solid
and you take a few tentative steps just to be sure. Wherever this place is,
it has a roughly square shape and appears to be surrounded by some kind of
sphere. Situated right in the middle of the cloud is a large column within
which you are standing.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
You gaze around at the sights before you, but unfortunately there's not a
lot to see. The cloud is rather featureless and any attemp to pass beyond
the sphere is met with some form of resistance. A large column rises from
the middle of the cloud to the west.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
The ground rolls beneath you, leaving you slightly unsteady on your feet.
The cloud is relatively featureless compared to some of the other areas you
may have adventured in the past...the only distinguishing feature is the large
column of mist that rises from the center of the cloud.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
From the base of the cloud, four small pillars rise up as if pushed from
below. The pillars themselves are nothing more than mist, but they retain
a somewhat solid form. Above each, a small sphere materialises and glows
softly with a rhythmic pulse.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
There is a definate presence nearby and you imagine that something or
someone is looking down upon you. A light breeze sends a shiver down your
spine and you try hard not to let your imagination loose. Perhaps it's better
if you just continued on.

rooms.name: The Aerial Plane
rooms.desc:
You find yourself standing on what appears to be a cloud, yet there is no
sky, nor is there any ground. Darkness surrounds you but you can see several
other clouds nearby, all beyond your reach. In the center of the cloud is a
strange column that rotates slowly.

rooms.name: The Aerial Plane
rooms.desc:
You step towards the edge of cloud and you feel a tingling sensation
all over your body. There is a brilliant flash and when you open your eyes,
you find yourself...

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
The island surface, although solid enough, is rather brittle and you
break through it several times. You cast your eye westwards, out upon the
sea of lava and find nothing. Flames dance along the surface of the lava
while huge plumes leap into the sky at irregular intervals.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
As you approach the edge of the island, a large jet of flame explodes from
the lave pool and travels upwards. Surprisingly, it doesn't radiate any heat
although testing that theory could be hazardous.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
Just beyond reach to the east lies a lava fountain, quite possibly the
source for the lava pool which surrounds the island. It bubbles away quietly,
obvious very hot given the viscosity of the fluid as it flows out. However,
you can feel no heat despite being so close.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
The lava pool simply ceases at the boundary of the sphere, beyond that
lies nothing but darkness. The lava bubbles away with intense heat but from
an unknown source since this place appears to be entirely surrounded by the
sphere.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
You stand within a column of fire which marks the center of a small island.
Created by some form of volcanic activity, the island is the only solid ground
within viewing distance - lava surrounds it making travel anywhere else
impossible. The island also appears to be enclosed within some kind of sphere,
but from your vantage point you can't be too sure.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
There is a slightly elevated portion of the island resembling a small
pillar. It's about waist-high and rather nondescript, although engraved on
the top is a picture of a small flame. The island continues to the north, south
and west where a large column of fire slowly rotates.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
You look outwards into the darkness and notice three similar spheres to
the one you are in now. The four in total surround a larger sphere but from
your position, you are unable to see what lies in any of them nor can you
see any way of reaching them.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
The sphere that surrounds the island has the unique ability to distort
light that provides for an interesting effect. There is an eerie orange glow
created by the bursts of flames that leap from the lava pool. Any flames
that reach the surface of the sphere create a rippling effect that spreads
out around the sphere.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
Steam gently rises from the ground and wafts upwards before disappearing
completely. Lava laps at the edge and small pools are left to cool, perhaps
adding to the islands' growth. There is no heat being radiated from either
the lava or the flames on its surface, leaving you slightly perplexed.

rooms.name: The Fiery Plane
rooms.desc:
You stand on a slab of cooled, volcanic lava that seems quite isolated
from anything else. You look around and discover there almost is nothing else
apart from similar slabs at very locations around you. Other than that, there
is only darkness. In the middle of the slab is a strange column that rotates
slowly.

rooms.name: The Fiery Plane
rooms.desc:
You step towards the edge of the slab and you feel a tingling sensation
all over your body. There is a brilliant flash and when you open your eyes,
you find yourself...

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
On the outer edge of the whirlpool, the pull is not as strong and you have
a chance to survey your surrounds. The sphere surrounding this place lies
just beyond arms reach but even if you could get to it, there's nothing
beyond it.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
You swim towards the edge of the whirlpool and rest a little, allowing the
current to spin you around slowly. There appears to be some kind of sphere
just a little further to the north, and beyond that nothing but darkness. You
can swim to the west, east or south from here.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
On the outer edge of the whirlpool, the pull is not as strong and you have
a chance to survey your surrounds. The sphere surrounding this place lies
just beyond arms reach but even if you could get to it, there's nothing
beyond it.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
You're tossed and turned in the churning waters and have some trouble trying
to stay afloat. The current, while not as strong as the middle of the
whirlpool, is certainly strong enough to pull you around. You can fight it and
swim to the north, south or east.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
Rough waters toss you back and forth as you fight to keep your head above
the waves. You're in the middle of a swirling whirlpool which, while trying
to move you around, does not appear to be sucking you down. There is a column
of water around you, its origin from the depths of the whirlpool itself.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
You are pushed into the sphere surrounding the whirlpool and it stretches
before pushing you back into the churning waters. Your impact causes a ripple
that spreads over the surface of the sphere in an interesting pattern. The
only notable item of interest is the large water column to the west.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
On the outer edge of the whirlpool, the pull is not as strong and you have
a chance to survey your surrounds. The sphere surrounding this place lies
just beyond arms reach but even if you could get to it, there's nothing
beyond it.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
You barely avoid a chunk of rock that sits within the churning waters of
the whirlpool. There's nothing remarkable about it except that it's the only
feature within visible range.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
On the outer edge of the whirlpool, the pull is not as strong and you have
a chance to survey your surrounds. The sphere surrounding this place lies
just beyond arms reach but even if you could get to it, there's nothing
beyond it.

rooms.name: The Aquatic Plane
rooms.desc:
You're swimming in a vast ocean and regardless of how hard you try,
movement in most directions seems futile - a force simply pushes you back to
this location. The sky has been replaced by a blackness, a void from which
no light escapes. Nearby, a strange column of water rotates slowly.

rooms.name: The Aquatic Plane
rooms.desc:
You step towards the edge of cloud and you feel a tingling sensation
all over your body. There is a brilliant flash and when you open your eyes,
you find yourself...

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
Made from the same material as the chamber itself, a small pillar stands
here in the corner approximately waist-high. There is a symbol etched onto
the top but nothing else remarkable stands out to you.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. You look around for an obvious exit from the chamber and
see none - the only clue would perhaps lie within the column.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. The hum of the central column is quite peaceful and
relaxing but there is a force within this chamber which leaves you on guard.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. Looking around the chamber, you notice that everything
seems to revolve around the column in the middle as if it played a key role
in the function of the chamber.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
Made from the same material as the chamber itself, a small pillar stands
here in the corner approximately waist-high. There is a symbol etched onto
the top but nothing else remarkable stands out to you.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. In the center of the chamber sits a giant column, it glows
an eerie red as it rotates.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. You can venture in any direction throughout the
chamber.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. Sunlight beams in from several openings in the
chamber walls and ceiling, but whether it is real or synthetic is anyone's
guess.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. You cannot see any exit from the chamber and can
only assume that the column is the key which you seek.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. The air is stale in this place and it feels as if no one
has ventured here in centuries, whatever purpose this chamber may have served.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. You can proceed along the western wall of the chamber or
further towards the center by travelling eastwards.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. Small, pulsing spheres materialise in the corner
of the chamber and make their way to the large column to the east before
disappearing in a puff of light.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber is quite large and its walls are engraved with all manner of
arcane symbols. In each corner is a small pedestal but from here, not much
detail can be seen. There is a rotating column in the middle of the chamber,
only feet from where you stand - there is a soft hum associated with its
movement and it radiates an enormous amount of energy.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. There is a definate force at work within the chamber
and all of your senses point towards the column to the west. You are almost
drawn to it with some type of hypnotic acceptance.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. You can continue to the north, south or west.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. For a brief moment, the column in the middle of the chamber
stops rotating, pulses intensely, and then resumes.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. Despite the sterile nature of this place, it feels
as if it has not been used in centuries...whatever that use may have been.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. You can venture in any direction throughout the
chamber.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. Your movements echo around the chamber and drown
out the soft hum coming from the column in the center of the room.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. As you touch one of the unknown symbols, there is a quiet
musical tone that resonates throughout the chamber.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
Made from the same material as the chamber itself, a small pillar stands
here in the corner approximately waist-high. There is a symbol etched onto
the top but nothing else remarkable stands out to you.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. Light beams in from several openings in the chamber wall
but whether it's real or not cannot be determined from down here.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. In the center of the chamber sits a giant column, it glows
an eerie red as it rotates.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. A number of colored spheres appear from nowhere and make
their way towards the column on an unknown journey. Upon reaching their
destination, they simply vanish in a puff of light.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
Made from the same material as the chamber itself, a small pillar stands
here in the corner approximately waist-high. There is a symbol etched onto
the top but nothing else remarkable stands out to you.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
Above the ambient noise of the temple, there is a soft chanting but you
can't see the source. The temple is devoid of other people apart from your
own adventuring party. It is, however, a very soothing chant and you take
a moment to sit and listen.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
A series of steps lead up to a magnificient altar in the middle of the
temple. This lower area has been set aside for people to kneel and worship
the elements, a number of pews set up around the temple perimeter.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
Looking around the temple, it is empty apart from the wooden pews and the
mystical altar. It is clearly meant to be the focus of this place despite the
fact that there is no one else here to worship it.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
A series of steps lead up to a magnificient altar in the middle of the
temple. This lower area has been set aside for people to kneel and worship
the elements, a number of pews set up around the temple perimeter.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
You stand before a great altar to the elements, a symbol of their union
and place within this world. Steps lead down in the four cardinal directions
to a small area surrounding the altar, an area to worship and pay homage.
There is a narrow opening in the temple ceiling which leads into the darkness.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
A series of steps lead up to a magnificient altar in the middle of the
temple. This lower area has been set aside for people to kneel and worship
the elements, a number of pews set up around the temple perimeter.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
There is a strong life force within the temple, you can feel it as it
seems to look you over. You do not feel in any danger, just an overwhelming
inquisitiveness. Then, as quickly as it came, the force is gone and you are
left standing here.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
A series of steps lead up to a magnificient altar in the middle of the
temple. This lower area has been set aside for people to kneel and worship
the elements, a number of pews set up around the temple perimeter.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
There are a number of pews lining the temple wall, each appears to have
an elemental symbol etched into. You take the time to sit down on a couple of
them and images of places far beyond this world enter your mind. Some you
recognise, most you do not - it is a very therapeutic experience.

rooms.name: The Elemental Plane
rooms.desc:
One minute your ascending through the opening in the temple roof, and the
next you are floating towards the top of a large sphere in openness. Around
the sphere is nothing, only blackness - orbitting at some distance are four
other spheres, all smaller than this one. There is an incredible power and
you are almost paralysed with its intensity.

rooms.name: A Tropical Island
rooms.desc:
The island isn't very large and you imagine if the ocean swell were to
rise sufficiently, it would be submerged. A single palm tree stands to your
right and a stone cross sits embedded within the soft sand.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the churning surface of the water.  As 
you float above the surface, eddies crash into you, forcing you to 
pay attention to the water's motion.  In the distance, you can see 
the foam of a broken ocean eddies. To the north, a lone island breaks
the surface of the waves.
